_readme: Sponsorship and Partnership Opportunities page (/sponsorship/). Summarizes Len's sponsorship guide (Word doc in public/docs/, Oct 23, 2026). Prices and availability come from that guide: update both together.

seo.title: Sponsorship and Partnership Opportunities
seo.description: Sponsor the Raving Patients Podcast, the Reputation Matters newsletter, Instagram campaigns and seminars with Dr. Len Tau. Reach dentists, practice owners and their teams.

intro.title: Reach dentists | who already | trust me.
paragraphs: I connect dental companies with dentists, practice owners, team members, consultants and industry decision-makers through content, education, speaking and trusted relationships.
Below is a summary of every option. My sponsorship guide has the full details, what is included and the fine print.

why.title: Clinical credibility. Business experience. Dental industry reach.
why.lead: I practiced dentistry for 23 years, 15 of them as a practice owner.
paragraphs: I know the clinical, operational, financial and patient-facing side of running a practice because I lived it every day.

Today my work is helping practices become more visible, build trust, improve case acceptance and grow. I look at your product and your message the way a former owner, consultant and speaker would. I am not a general influencer.

My reach sits inside dentistry, so you get a focused professional audience, not a broad consumer following. Every company, product, topic and claim is reviewed for fit. Educational integrity comes first.

event.title: Supercharge Your | Dental Practice.
paragraphs: My annual business, marketing and leadership conference in Fort Lauderdale, South Florida.
More than 200 dentists and team members attend, along with more than 50 exhibitors and sponsors.

cards.title: Credibility
cards.text: Alignment with a trusted dental voice.

packages.title: Ten ways | to partner.
packages.intro: Pick one, or I will build a combination around your launch, event or goal.

items.title: Featured Podcast Guest or Featured Company
items.availability: Subject to scheduling and topic approval
items.text: Your executive, founder, clinician or expert joins me on the Raving Patients Podcast. It is an educational conversation, not labeled as a sponsored session.
includes: Professionally recorded episode
Planning and production support
Promotional assets and reusable content
About 1,300 downloads per episode
items.best: Thought leadership, founder visibility and product education.

items.title: Overall Podcast Sponsor
items.text: One of four overall sponsors, with mentions and a host-read commercial in every new episode. The final spot must be in a noncompeting category.
includes: One recorded episode featuring your company
Mention at the start and end of each episode
One host-read commercial per episode
Rotating approved messaging

items.title: Reputation Matters Newsletter Sponsor
items.price: $800 per month for 6 months, or $600 per month for 12
items.text: My weekly newsletter goes to more than 5,000 subscribers. This adds preferred-resource positioning and a podcast episode.
includes: An ad in every weekly newsletter
Callout as a preferred resource
One featured podcast episode
Approved link to your site or scheduling page
items.best: Sustained email visibility with dental decision-makers.

items.title: Instagram Promotion Package
items.text: A four-post campaign to nearly 50,000 followers that builds awareness and sends dentists to learn more.
includes: One post a week for four weeks
You supply the core creative and approved claims
Video, product highlights, testimonials or education
items.best: Launches, promotions, events and new offers.

items.title: Preferred Resource Partnership
items.text: Your company joins my trusted resource network with coordinated visibility across several channels.
includes: Placement on my Favorites page, shared with my seminar attendees
Verbal recommendations when relevant
One featured podcast episode, a newsletter callout and a social post
Social Media Watchdog monitoring
items.best: Established companies that want trusted, ongoing positioning.

items.title: Case Acceptance Seminar Featured Company
items.text: Be featured in Supercharge Case Acceptance Using Software or Technology, a seminar I present several times a year that walks through every step a patient takes, from first search to scheduled treatment.
includes: Placement at the step of the patient experience your product supports
Fits software, diagnostics, communication, scheduling, financing and follow-up
items.best: Products that help practices increase case acceptance.

items.title: Dedicated Newsletter Feature
items.text: A dedicated email about one company, product, webinar, offer, case study or event.
includes: Sponsor-focused email to the full list
Your value proposition, links and call to action
Optional video mention
items.best: Launches, webinar registration and limited-time offers.

items.title: Sponsored Live Interview or Webinar
items.availability: Based on calendar and topic fit
items.text: A 30 to 60 minute live or recorded educational program with me and your representative.
includes: Promotion through selected channels
Live or submitted audience questions
Recording for approved reuse
Optional registration and lead capture
items.best: Companies that need time to educate or demonstrate.

items.title: Product Launch Campaign
items.text: A coordinated campaign around a product release, major feature, rebrand or announcement.
includes: Featured podcast episode
Newsletter placement and Instagram promotion
Facebook group exposure when appropriate
Short-form video, campaign planning and optional webinar
items.best: Several coordinated touchpoints instead of one promotion.

items.title: Brand Ambassador Partnership
items.availability: A small number of noncompeting companies
items.text: A deeper partnership for an ongoing, credible presence in the dental industry.
includes: Recurring social content, podcast and newsletter exposure
Preferred resource placement and Social Media Watchdog
Periodic strategy calls and feedback from a former practice owner
Event or speaking visibility when permitted
items.best: Sustained category awareness and strategic input.

packages.custom: Custom combinations are available. Pricing depends on scope, frequency, production, exclusivity and usage rights.

guidelines.title: How I work with sponsors.
list: All companies, topics, products and claims are reviewed and approved first.
Category conflicts may limit availability or require exclusivity pricing.
Products are included only when they are relevant to the audience and the program.
Using my name, image, voice or endorsement in paid ads needs written approval and may involve licensing fees.
Speaking-event exposure follows organizer, venue and session rules.
Exposure does not guarantee leads, sales, downloads or engagement.
Scope, schedule, payment, cancellation, deliverables and usage rights go into a written agreement.

cta.title: Let's build the | right partnership.
cta.text: Tell me what you want to promote, who you want to reach, your timing and the outcome you want. I will recommend the option that fits.
